create_AtomsSequence_protocol: create a runtime-checkable Protocol class that defines indexing and length for sequences of ASE Atoms objects
implement_AtomsDatasetSequence: implement a wrapper class that turns an AseAtomsDataset into an AtomsSequence for iterating over atoms
use_AtomsDatasetSequence_getitem: use AtomsDatasetSequence to retrieve an individual Atoms object by integer index from the underlying dataset
use_AtomsDatasetSequence_len: use AtomsDatasetSequence to get the total number of atoms objects in the wrapped dataset
check_AtomsSequence_protocol: check at runtime whether an object conforms to the AtomsSequence protocol using isinstance
